patch.value: GH-1330: per-command JSON help inherits the root intent and init example

GitHub issue #1330 reports that 55 of 137 command paths in pm help <command> --json inherit the root intent and pm init example without a provenance marker. This gives agents a misleading action for graph, extension, assurance, and history commands. Source: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1330

Reproduce the 55-of-137 census on the affected release; correct JSON help ownership and provenance; add a negative-control contract test across all command paths; verify generated docs and exact coverage
Every command help response describes its own intent or explicitly marks missing or inherited guidance
Prevent agents from following unrelated init examples during command discovery
Keep machine-readable help trustworthy and token efficient
No non-root help response silently repeats root intent or examples
Compare pm help graph --json and pm help history activity --json with pm help --json; both inherit root intent and pm init example on 2026.9.27.
Root intent and pm init example are silently returned on unrelated command paths.
